title: Disney Movie Club Snow White Silver Ornament with Sparkles
descriptionText: The Disney Movie Club Snow White Ornament is a beautiful silver tone ornament featuring Snow White from the beloved Disney franchise. Made of metal with sparkles for added glamor, this contemporary collectible is perfect for Disney fans and collectors alike. The ornament is a Disney Movie Club exclusive, making it a special addition to any holiday decor or collection. Snow White's iconic character and timeless story are beautifully captured in this charming ornament.
